svg.title: Example with made-up inputs: monthly EI on standard versus extended parental benefits
svg.desc: Example with made-up inputs. Average weekly insurable earnings of $1,000, under the weekly maximums on the Service Canada page. Standard parental is 55 percent, $550 a week, about $2,383.33 a month. Extended parental is 33 percent, $330 a week, $1,430 a month. The one-parent maximum totals are not equal.
svg.text: Example with made-up inputs: parental benefits, per month
Made-up weekly insurable earnings of $1,000. A month here is 52 weeks divided by 12.
Weekly amounts are $550 and $330. Both are under the page's caps of $729 and $437.
One parent, maximum parental weeks only: 35 times $550 is $19,250.
The same parent on extended: 61 times $330 is $20,130. The totals are not the same number.
Maternity, if it applies, is 15 weeks at 55 percent on either choice. It is not in these two bars.
Quebec uses the Quebec Parental Insurance Plan. These bars are the EI rates outside Quebec.
Service Canada page details 2 June 2026. Not a payment quote. Confirm with the estimator.
Saving Optimizer. Example with made-up inputs. As of 29 Sep 2026.
